string process(const string& s, size_t pos, bool& firstAt) {
    if (pos >= s.size()) return "";
    if (firstAt && pos + 1 < s.size() && s[pos] == 'a' && s[pos+1] == 't') {
        firstAt = false;
        return "@" + process(s, pos + 2, firstAt);
    }
    if (pos + 2 < s.size() && s[pos] == 'd' && s[pos+1] == 'o' && s[pos+2] == 't' && pos + 2 != s.size() - 1) {
        return "." + process(s, pos + 3, firstAt);
    }
    return s[pos] + process(s, pos + 1, firstAt);
}

int main() {
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    bool firstAt = true;
    string res = s[0] + process(s, 1, firstAt);
    cout << res;
    return 0;
